answer: Atlas sponsor-decay bond: a newcomer enters only via a sponsor who locks a 70-credit bond under a copper seal and logs a reputation signal in the atlas ledger. Honest sponsorship lifts the signal by 5; a cheating protege cuts it 25 and slashes 10 credits, and a sponsor below 50 can never sponsor again. Each fake costs 115 (45 fee plus the 70 bond), so 1,000 fakes cost 115,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond.
